599:t_102:3.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Everyone rejected the $$時の牢獄$$! I'm not about to listen to your selfish logic!」

599:t_103:0.en:
$$正太郎$$
「I'll stop you and end this war between humans right here!」

599:t_103:1.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Then let me ask. If you were to win, would that mean eternal peace?」

599:t_103:3.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「You don't seem confident. That is only a natural reaction.」

599:t_103:4.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「But I will state this plainly. If it is I, I can bring tranquility to the world.」

599:t_103:5.en:
$$正太郎$$
「All that does is take everyone's freedom away! That is not what you call peace!」

599:t_103:6.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Let's do this, $$鉄人$$! The peace after we beat that man won't be made by some one person, it'll be built by everyone in the world!」

599:t_104:0.en:
$$甲児$$
「If we leave Earth to you, all that awaits is a world with no dreams or hope!」

599:t_104:1.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Are you saying that you could give those to people?」

599:t_104:2.en:
$$甲児$$
「Dreams and hope are something everyone holds on their own! All I'm doing is fighting to protect them!」

599:t_104:3.en:
$$甲児$$
「Here we go, $$フル・フロンタル$$! I'll end the legend of the $$赤い彗星$$ right here!」

599:t_105:0.en:
$$竜馬$$
「You brought a machine fit for a final battle, didn't you! Looks like it'll be satisfying to smash!」

599:t_105:1.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「This $$ネオ・ジオング$$ is a symbol of hope for the new people of space. I cannot let you destroy it.」

599:t_105:2.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Don't worry! Even if that thing goes down, everyone's hope won't disappear!」

599:t_105:3.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Because we'll be the ones fighting to protect it!」

599:t_106:0.en:
$$タケル$$
「The future people wished for isn't a world where they merely stay alive! It's a world where they live alongside hope!」

599:t_106:1.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「There is such a thing as happiness suited to one's station. Unfortunately, the happiness that people living in this world now can obtain is not very much.」

599:t_106:2.en:
$$タケル$$
「That's logic you decided on your own! Nobody wants a world filled with resignation from the start!」

599:t_106:3.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「That is precisely your own selfish logic. As a vessel, I merely act in response to people's wish to survive.」

599:t_106:4.en:
$$タケル$$
「Then we'll fight our way to victory! We'll overcome you, defeat the $$サイデリアル$$, and win the world everyone wants that lies beyond!」

599:t_107:0.en:
$$シモン$$
「Now that it's come to this, we don't need logic! You have no intention of listening to us anyway!」

599:t_107:1.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「By the same token, you have no intention of listening to my words either.」

599:t_107:2.en:
$$シモン$$
「Then there's only one thing to do! My drill will pierce that prized new machine of yours and your ambition!」

599:t_107:3.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Heh... If the world were as simple and clear-cut as you, things would be much easier.」

599:t_107:4.en:
$$シモン$$
「You're the only one overthinking this! I'm just fighting for the ordinary happiness everyone wants!!」

599:t_108:0.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「With this $$ネオ・ジオング$$, I won't lose to your machine in power, either.」

599:t_108:1.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Don't underestimate $$ガンバスター$$! $$ガンバスター$$'s strength isn't power, it's the power of the feelings that dwell within it!」

599:t_108:2.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Then I, the vessel that gathers people's will, will show you that power of feelings as well.」

599:t_108:4.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「And then we'll stop you here and end the fighting!」

599:t_109:0.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Wake up already! Humanity has to join forces and fight a colossal enemy, doesn't it!」

599:t_109:1.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Do you mean the $$サイデリアル$$? Or $$バアル$$?」

599:t_109:3.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「That is exactly what is meaningless. That's why I join hands with the $$サイデリアル$$ and fight $$バアル$$ with their power.」

599:t_109:4.en:
$$ラルク$$
「You'd throw away human freedom and pride for that!」

599:t_109:5.en:
$$ラルク$$
「That's not called joining hands! It's called surrendering!!」

599:t_110:0.en:
$$ノノ$$
「$$ノノ$$ and the others will stop you right here! Because...!」

599:t_110:1.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「$$ノノ$$ and the others will stop you right here! Because...!」

599:t_110:2.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「$$ノノ$$ and the others will stop you right here! Because...!」

599:t_110:3.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「I have no time to humor nonsense.」

599:t_110:4.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Wait a moment, please! Don't you want to hear what comes after 'because...'!」

599:t_110:5.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「Wait a moment, please! Don't you want to hear what comes after 'because...'!」

599:t_110:6.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「Wait a moment, please! Don't you want to hear what comes after 'because...'!」

599:t_110:7.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「I am tired of hearing the positive pipe dreams you all are so good at.」

599:t_110:8.en:
$$ノノ$$
「I'm going to say it anyway! Because...!」

599:t_110:9.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「I'm going to say it anyway! Because...!」

599:t_110:10.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「I'm going to say it anyway! Because...!」

599:t_110:11.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Because $$ノノ$$ and the others believe in hope, believe in the future, and believe in victory!」

599:t_110:12.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「Because $$ノノ$$ and the others believe in hope, believe in the future, and believe in victory!」

599:t_110:13.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「Because $$ノノ$$ and the others believe in hope, believe in the future, and believe in victory!」

599:t_111:0.en:
$$葵$$
「I've seen all kinds of villains, but you're different from every one of them. You're a breed apart.」

599:t_111:1.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「I doubt you have the right to condemn me as evil.」

599:t_111:2.en:
$$葵$$
「I don't intend to call myself a champion of justice...」

599:t_111:3.en:
$$葵$$
「But you know what! I won't accept you, someone who twists everyone's will to move toward the future and can only preserve the status quo!」

599:t_111:4.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「The blood of the beast... I see.」

599:t_111:5.en:
$$葵$$
「Here we go, $$フル・フロンタル$$! The fight since the $$時獄戦役$$ ends here!」

599:t_112:0.en:
$$赤木$$
「Stop fighting! If you'd just back down, the fighting between humans would end!」

599:t_112:1.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「But what waits beyond that is a future of despair.」

599:t_112:2.en:
$$赤木$$
「All humans will join forces and fight to overcome it!」

599:t_112:3.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「I have no intention of approving a world that forces such sacrifices.」

599:t_112:4.en:
$$赤木$$
「That doesn't mean I can believe a world where we surrender to the $$サイデリアル$$ and are kept alive out of pity is right!」

599:t_112:5.en:
$$赤木$$
「We can all decide together what's right! That's why I'm going to stop you here and end the fighting!」

599:t_113:0.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Regrettably, it does not look like I can overturn your logic with the power of words.」

599:t_113:1.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「For a negotiator like you to raise the white flag.」

599:t_113:2.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Do not misunderstand. It is because you call yourself a vessel, yet never accept other people.」

599:t_113:3.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Debate cannot take place with that kind of person.」

599:t_113:4.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Then what will you do?」

599:t_113:5.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Against my wishes, I will stop you by force.」

599:t_113:6.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「The world now demands that we do so! I will merely carry it out!」

599:t_114:0.en:
$$アポロ$$
「No matter how many words you line up, you're a loser who wagged your tail for the Empire!」

599:t_114:2.en:
$$アポロ$$
「I can't let someone like that decide where the world is headed!」

599:t_114:3.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「So you will strike me down irresponsibly, and then what do you intend to do afterward?」

599:t_114:4.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Where the world is headed gets decided by everyone living in it!」

599:t_114:5.en:
$$アポロ$$
「That know-it-all fake $$赤い彗星$$ getting in the way of that, I'll knock him out of the sky!」

599:t_115:0.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Are you fine with the world going on like this, exactly as it is now!」

599:t_115:2.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「But I believe that is the only way for humanity to survive.」

kept_omissions: 599:t_113:1: sentence fragment kept as in Japanese (verb-less: 'For a negotiator like you to raise the white flag.')
uncertain: 599:t_106:4: 俺達を勝ち取ってみせる is odd (object of 勝ち取る unclear); rendered 'we'll fight our way to victory' then 'win the world everyone wants'.
599:t_114:5: 頭でっかち = 'know-it-all' (could be 'all theory'); 'him' used for Frontal (glossary male).
599:t_111:4: Frontal's 獣の血…か kept literal ('The blood of the beast... I see'); referent (Aoi's heritage/ferocity) not verifiable in this slice.
599:t_108:0: 君の機体 taken as aimed at Noriko (Gunbuster), per her reply, not Simon.
599:t_103:0/t_112:0 etc.: first/plural person for Japanese-unmarked 'I' chosen per speaker's singular style; Shotaro 'I'll stop you'.
599:t_109:3: それこそ無意味だ = 'That is exactly what is meaningless' (that = humans uniting against Sidereal/Baal).
599:t_103:4: 平穏 rendered 'tranquility' (not 'peace') to keep it distinct from 平和.
